sources.title: whisper-small.en: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Choose whisper-small.en if you prioritize speed and acceptable accuracy; pick whisper-medium.en if accuracy on difficult audio justifies the compute overhead. Q: What are the known failure modes? A: The model can hallucinate text not actually spoken in the audio, particularly on low-quality audio with long silences or dominant background noise.

sources.title: whisper-small: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-small is a 244-million-parameter multilingual speech recognition and translation model developed by openai. Built as a Transformer-based encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture, it was trained on 680,000 hours of labeled speech data using large-scale weak supervision and demonstrates strong generalization across datasets and domains without fine-tuning. sources.title: Whisper Small (English) — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: Whisper Small.en is OpenAI's 244M-parameter English-only Whisper checkpoint. It uses the standard Whisper encoder-decoder architecture for automatic speech recognition, trained with large-scale weak supervision on 680k hours of labelled speech.

sources.title: aneforge/whisper-base.en · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Whisper base.en (ANEForge) An unmodified duplicate of openai/whisper-base.en, tagged for use with ANEForge so the weights load and run directly on the Apple Neural Engine (no CoreML). Weights are byte-identical to the source; see the original repo for the model details. Licensed apache-2.0 from the source.
